## Change / 변경 내용

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For translations, include the screen
and reason for the wording change.

## Validation / 검증

List checks actually run: fixtures, JSON/PowerShell verification, package build,
local source token/coverage check, and any in-game results with exact versions.
Say which checks were not performed.

## Evidence and limits / 근거와 남은 검수

Include relevant screenshots or log excerpts without personal data. Confirm any
new assets have documented sources and licenses. Do not include game files,
extracted English/Japanese tables or generated interop assemblies.
